routes.label: Count the values in the class

question: There are 12 data values: 3, 7, 12, 8, 15, 9, 14, 6, 11, 13, 5, 10. They are grouped using a class width of 5, with each class including its left endpoint and excluding its right endpoint, into \([0,5)\), \([5,10)\), \([10,15)\), and \([15,20)\). What is the frequency of the class \([10,15)\)?
solution: The data values satisfying \(10\le x<15\) are 12, 14, 11, 13, and 10, giving 5 values in total (15 belongs to the next class).
